method.footprints: LoD2.2 semantic GroundSurface union; lowest valid face fallback
method.height: real LoD2.2 solid Z (NAP); representative height retained for the index only
method.roofs: real LoD2.2 solid facets (walls + roofs); flat 2.5D extrusion only as a no-solid fallback

historicalCaveat: A 1941 approximation based on surviving/current BAG geometry; buildings demolished after 1941 cannot be reconstructed from this source.
